title: Analysis of hair cortisol levels in captive chimpanzees: Effect of various methods on cortisol stability and variability
author: Yamanashi, Teramoto, et al.

steps.title: Collect hair sample
steps.instruction: Cut approximately 200 mg of arm hair from each chimpanzee using scissors.

steps.title: Wash hair with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 5 ml of isopropanol to the tube containing the hair, shake for 2 min, repeat the shaking three times, then allow the hair to dry.

steps.title: Store washed hair
steps.instruction: Keep the dried hair at ambient temperature until further processing.

steps.title: Grind hair to powder
steps.instruction: Weigh about 150 mg of the dried hair, place it in a Precellys 24 tissue homogenizer tube, and grind for 4 min at 6500 rpm (Bertin Technologies, Orléans, France).

steps.title: Weigh powdered hair
steps.instruction: Transfer the powdered hair to a 2‑ml tube and weigh a minimum of 5 mg.

steps.title: Add extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of methanol to the tube containing the powdered hair.

steps.title: Extract cortisol
steps.instruction: Shake the tube for 24 h at ambient temperature to extract cortisol.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube (speed not specified), then aliquot 0.6 ml of the supernatant into a new tube.

steps.title: Evaporate solvent
steps.instruction: Place the 0.6 ml supernatant in a vacuum oven and evaporate at 80 °C until dry.

steps.title: Reconstitute extract
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the dried residue with phosphate buffer (volume not specified).

steps.title: Measure cortisol concentration
steps.instruction: Determine cortisol levels using the Salimetrics Salivary Cortisol enzyme immunoassay kit (Salimetrics LLC, Philadelphia, PA, USA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
